description.value:
While the face of warfare has changed to support nanotech payloads, liquid-crystal armorgels, and smart-guided tank shells, nothing beats a good old-fashioned 25mm anti-tank round fired out of a giant fuck-off gun. The M2052 Liberator does not care about its user, its target, the wall in front of its target, or anything else beyond punching fist-sized holes through whatever it’s fired at. If complaints about the M2050 model hadn’t forced the addition of a basic bipod, the only Liberators left would be fielded by FBCs and Nomad-built tanks. Supposedly a favorite of Militech Special Forces during the Unification War, because while the Liberator ain’t smart, efficient, or quiet, it can drop anyone — Arasaka-supplied armor or otherwise — in one trigger pull.

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Anti-Material Rifle

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Bipod, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Armor-Piercing Ammunition (100eb (Premium) per round) that also functions as Burrowing Ammunition. All Ammunition fired from this weapon also functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets. Firing this weapon without being knocked Prone and suffering the Broken Ribs Critical Injury requires BODY 13+, or BODY 11+ and being Prone, or being Mounted. This weapon’s thunderous muzzle report cannot be silenced or suppressed by any means.

Range: Anti-Material Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
